For Non-applicant : Ms. Nandkumari Kashyap, Panel Lawyer  Hon'ble Shri Parth Prateem Sahu, Judge  ORDER ON BOARD 15/02/2024 1.

Applicant has filed this first bail application under Section 439 of CrPC for grant of regular bail as he has been arrested in connection with Crime No. 409/2023 registered at Police Station - Bhatapara City, District Baloda Bazar Bhatapara (C.G.) for offence punishable under Section 456, 376, 506 of IPC.
2. Case of prosecution in brief is that in the intervening night of 11- 12.11.2023 at about 12:00 to 1:00 hour when victim Mahesiya Bai was sleeping in her house, at that time applicant entered into the house and under threat has committed forceful sexual intercourse with her.
Incident was reported by the daughter-in-law in the morning, based upon which aforementioned crime was registered.
3. Learned counsel for applicant submits that applicant has been falsely implicated in the crime, he has not committed any offence as alleged.
As per the material available in the charge-sheet, it is appearing that the victim is aged about 65 years and suffering with paralysis and therefore also the allegations are false on its face.
Hence, applicant may be enlarged on bail.

4. Learned State counsel opposes the submission of learned counsel for applicant and submits that Raja Bhardwaj vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126253841/

sentences.text: as per allegation, applicant entered into the house, under threat committed forceful sexual intercourse with victim who is suffering with paralysis and is unable to move with her own.
Immediately in the morning when her daughter-in-law reached her, she narrated the entire story.
5. I have heard learned counsel for the parties.

6. Taking into consideration, facts and circumstances of the case, nature of allegation, the manner in which the crime is alleged to have been committed with a woman aged about 65 years suffering with paralysis, I do not find present to be a fit case to allow this application.
7. Accordingly, this application filed under Section 439 of CrPC is rejected.
